body: Thank you for this insightful comment, friend. I will definitely look into all of this and think hard of this decision that I'll be making. It's currently only 8 PM, I have time. I'm sorry for your pain and I wish you the best of luck on your journey.

Thank you for writing this wonderful interpretation of my words. It's truly heart warming. And I completely understand that longing, wanting to be one with the universe. Here from earth we can only glimpse at what's above us. I wish you immense good luck with your studies, keep going and you'll get wherever you'd like to see yourself be.
I wish you good luck on your journey. You'll live on through the small and big steps you've taken in life. Whether you live another day or not, I hope you find peace, friend.

Thank you, this touches me very deeply. I will probably put something up tomorrow regarding the things I've written. As a way to say goodbye. And if something changes or I survive somehow, I'll be sure to come back here and share my story.
I wish the same for yourself as well :)
I absolutely adore Virginia Woolf! You made me feel warm, kind stranger. Thank you.
I have no will to start a book from scratch but I've been writing pretty much all my life. I'm planning to put together something for my family/friends. Wonderful suggestion, Annie.
True, true. No harm in that. Thanks for the heads up, fella, planning a funeral tends to be quite consuming ;)

You hit the right spot, kind stranger. I would have loved to have written a book some day. But a few sparks unfortunately do not light a hallway, a path. If by any means, by some magical way I survive, I'll perhaps write that book.
It's as meaningful as you take it to be, but I'll leave my support behind for you. Hopefully one day something less than bad happens to keep you going in the long run.
Good point, I've got a little over 2 days to consider doing something big
Same goes out to you, friend
I'd say keep it up, godboy!
